eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 11:10 AM on AUG 31, 2021 Effective until 11:10 AM SEP 1, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is a Wildfire Mandatory Evacuation Order for Beckwourth Genesee Road East through Dixie Valley Rd to the Plumas Co line including Frenchman Lake  Leave the area immediately If you remain emergency personnel may not be able to help you  An evacuation at the 108 Taylor Avenue in Portola To view your evacuation zone go to community.zonehaven.com
